_comment: Resource nodes. Unlike loose ground pickups these deplete over several harvests and regrow, so a patch is a place you come back to rather than a one-shot. `surface` matches Terrain.Surface. `count` is a floor; `per_km2` scales the real thing to whatever region is loaded, because these numbers were first tuned against a 0.26 km2 test map and the real Hagga Basin South crop is 7.0 km2 -- the same counts there put the nearest agave 700 m from anywhere, which turns the Journey's second step into a ten-minute walk.

kinds.name: Wreck Debris
kinds._comment: Scattered on sand like every other node. It was anchored to the wiki's shipwreck markers, which sounded good and meant salvage existed only at ten points in 7 km2 -- and salvage is the first material the chain needs. Nothing asked for it to be special. It is not.

kinds.name: Copper Vein
kinds._comment: Kept off the small synthetic fixture. Adding any kind to a 512 m map changes its node density, and Phases 0-4 are pinned to that map so their tuned thresholds keep meaning what they meant. Suites that need copper there grant it.

kinds.name: Carbon Seam
kinds._comment: Steel is a late tier and the small fixture has no use for it, so carbon stays off the synthetic region.
